experiment: P2v reference-aligned phase-increment VFT Doppler physical sufficiency
research_question: Can a fixed-lag phase-increment estimator remove wide-grid multiple-comparison bias while preserving signed VFT Doppler OOD generalization?

failed_parent.experiment: P2u range-agnostic signed wide-grid VFT Doppler
failed_parent.failure_mechanism: Global argmax over a much wider grid improved negative OOD but introduced extreme-value false peaks and destroyed positive ID performance.

single_mechanism_change.name: reference-aligned fixed-lag complex phase increment
single_mechanism_change.delay_selection_score: phase_coherence multiplied by normalized gathered-pulse energy; reference correlation is used only to propose 32 delay candidates

controls.C3_wrong_reference: C2 with chirp rate multiplied by 0.8
controls.C4_no_delay_alignment: C2 with delay fixed to zero

stop_rule: Any failed physical gate stops P2v. Do not train a deeper VFT router or attach to the 12-parameter system. Diagnose saved predictions and use another fresh seed for a different mechanism.
